svg.text: door inside elevation, keep section D-D, cam section E-E
1. LockBar Ø10 with four lugs. The cam lifts it 22 mm; each lug then sits behind a keep on the frame, so the free edge of the door is held at four points 190 mm apart.
2. With the bar down the lugs pass clear of the keeps, so the door shuts without forcing anything; the throw is what locks it.
3. DogBolts Ø8, three on the hinge edge, engaged in keeps in the frame: grinding the hinges off still does not free the door.
4. CamLock — the only thing outside is the key barrel. No hasp, no shackle, nothing to cut.
5. The cam pin runs in a horizontal slot in the yoke: a quarter turn lifts the bar while the pin slides sideways in the slot.
